experiment: Unified Explainable CNN-Transformer Multi-Disease EEG Classification

scientific_provenance.healthy: SRM Healthy (sub-010) + OpenNeuro ds004504 Controls + OpenNeuro ds004584 Controls + NEMAR nm000114 Controls
scientific_provenance.epilepsy: CHB-MIT (7 independent subjects: chb01-chb05, chb07, chb08; Train: chb02/03/04/05/08, Val: chb07, Test: chb01)
scientific_provenance.depression: NEMAR nm000114 / MODMA (Major Depressive Disorder patients)
scientific_provenance.subject_leakage: ZERO (strictly independent subjects across Train, Val, and Test splits)
scientific_provenance.montage: Standard 19-channel 10-20 system (Fp1, Fp2, F7, F3, Fz, F4, F8, T3, C3, Cz, C4, T4, T5, P3, Pz, P4, T6, O1, O2), 256 Hz, 5-second windows

known_limitations: CHB-MIT: 7 independent subjects (chb01-chb05, chb07, chb08). Train: 5 subjects (326 windows), Val: 1 subject (57 windows), Test: 1 subject (55 windows). Strict subject-level splitting with zero leakage.
SRM Healthy: 1 subject (sub-010) assigned to Train split; healthy controls in Val/Test are sourced from OpenNeuro and NEMAR cohorts.
FTD (Frontotemporal Dementia): Excluded from ds004504 to maintain clean Alzheimer's vs Healthy boundary.
